answer_2.quote: We adopt two metrics from prior work on evaluating word-level explanations: the area over the perturbation curve (AOPC) and the log-odds scores, and define a new evaluation metric called cohesion-score to evaluate the interactions between words within a given text span.

answer_4.quote: We had 9 human annotators from the Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) for human evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: We provided the input text with different explanations in the user interface and asked human annotators to guess the model's prediction from {"Negative", "Positive", "N/A"} based on each explanation, where "N/A" was selected when annotators cannot guess the model's prediction.
